inputs.note: no capture file enters this run. The corpus is 24 literal vendor/branch strings written inside the analysis page, and the parser under test is the shipping clock.js — both are committed, so the inputs are the two files named under evidence

deterministic: every case is a pure function of its literal input and its options, and no clock, network or random source is read. A re-run under the SAME runner timezone reproduces these counts exactly. The runner timezone is an input, not a nuisance: see zoneDependence below

population.note: checked = eligible = 30 under each runner zone. Nothing is excluded: every case and every invariant reports in every run

claims.note: values EXACTLY as the paper states them, so CLAIM … FROM … #claims/<key> compares equal; full precision and the per-zone detail sit under result

zoneDependence.note: §∅ — the published 24/24 is a UTC-runner figure, and the paper did not say so until this block. The three cases that move are branch-1 epoch cases, and they move for the reason the paper's own §3 states: a bare epoch is a genuine instant, so the parser localises it to the runner's wall clock. The benchmark's expectation for those rows is a fixed epoch (want: 1751925600000), so the EXPECTATION is zone-pinned while the parser is not. The parser is behaving as documented
zoneDependence.invariantsAreZoneIndependent: all 6 hold in all 4 zones, as they must: each is a relative comparison, so none reads an absolute instant

unrepaired.note: found while measuring, repaired nowhere in this unit, and logged here because no residue row was available (one RESIDUE-only PR is in flight fleet-wide)
unrepaired.snapshotDisagreement: papers/timestamp-corpus.json records pass 21, fail 3 with the three epoch rows at ok:false and off=-240 — a US-Eastern runner. papers/timestamp-invariants.json records corpus { pass: 24, total: 24 }. §5 cites both as 'a committed run for diffing', and they are two runs in two different zones. Neither file is regenerated here: a silent rewrite would destroy the evidence of the disagreement
unrepaired.noGateRunsThisBenchmark: the analysis page is UNBUNDLED, so neither the provenance gate nor the behaviour gate opens it, and tools/analysis-rerun.mjs does not carry it. §5 calls the benchmark a regression guard; until something runs it in CI, that claim rests on a hand run

result.notMeasuredHere: §3.1 (the synthesised-axis pathology, Table 3) is a corpus observation and the paper's own scope note says the live benchmark does not regenerate it. No number in Table 3 is bound by this record
result.byCategoryNote: the category labels are this run’s, read from the rendered table. papers/timestamp-corpus.json carries older spellings (“Vendor: O2Ring”, “DMY/MDY”, “Malformed→null”) — a reminder that the committed snapshot is a different run
